title: The doorknob hit Mr Bloom in the small of the back as the door was pushed in.
html_source: Same technique as Mr Bloom stood in his way. Highly efficient spelling out of Bloom not being part of this lot. The external narrative punctuates the social intercourse of the press men’s banter. Bloom physically is in the way and personally is in the way. It is implicit and marked differentiation.
